[Jetzt buchen](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en#)

Anyone who sees the idyllic Val Müstair for the first time will be fascinated by the beauty and integrity of this corner of the world. In spring, magnificent flower meadows lure you next to ancient larch and stone pine forests. In summer and autumn, peaks, pass crossings and high-altitude trails offer breathtaking tours. In winter, the valley comes to rest and reveals itself as a fairytale world covered in deep snow. Welcome to the Biosfera Val Müstair!

[Mehr anzeigen](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/natural-winter-experiences)

![skating](https://www.val-muestair.ch/sites/valmuestair/files/styles/medium_teaser/public/2026-02/grfnordicstessvm_005.jpg?h=06ac0d8c&itok=KC9YU8YJ)

Naturally unique Winter activities in Val Müstair

Snow-covered landscapes, soothing tranquillity and a wide range of activities: discover the nature-filled winter experiences in Val Müstair and be inspired by the variety on offer.

[Learn more](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/natural-winter-experiences)

[Mehr anzeigen](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/erleben/wintersport/ski-touring)

![Skitour Rudi Müller](https://www.val-muestair.ch/sites/valmuestair/files/styles/medium_teaser/public/2023-12/skitour_-_rudi_mueller_-_berge.jpg?h=c9ac1d81&itok=HL8dFvfk)

In the midst of an impressive mountain world Ski tours

Quiet valleys, unspoilt slopes and peaks offering stunning views make ski touring in Val Müstair a special winter experience. Far from the hustle and bustle, in the heart of the UNESCO Biosphere.

[Learn more](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/erleben/wintersport/ski-touring)

Activities in Winter

Our offers

(G)astronomic experience

Enjoy a delicious stargazer's menu at the cozy Pension Hirschen in Lü. Afterwards, take a guided “eye walk” under the starry sky and peer through the Observatori astronomic's telescope to discover distant constellations and galaxies.

[Mehr anzeigen](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/lama-trial-tour)

![Lamatrekking ](https://www.val-muestair.ch/sites/valmuestair/files/styles/small_teaser_3_2_380w/public/2024-11/lamatrekking_winter.jpg?h=29234840&itok=2MV0sQuw)

Wed, 30.12.26 / 3.2. / 17.2. / 24.2. / 3.3.27

Lama trekking trial tour

Lama trekking taster tour accompanied by Isidor Sepp. A fun and entertaining hike for families and animal lovers.

[Mehr anzeigen](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/game-watching-winter)

![Wildtiere im Winter](https://www.val-muestair.ch/sites/valmuestair/files/styles/small_teaser_3_2_380w/public/2024-11/1080.jpg?h=170ba4b8&itok=Je6ApEuk)

Wed, 8.1. / 15.1. / 22.1. / 29.1.27

Wild animals in winter

Many wild animals live hidden away in winter and are rarely seen. But thanks to the trained eyes of our guides, chamois, ibex, and perhaps even golden eagles and bearded vultures can be observed. Participants will learn a lot about wild animals, birds, and large predators.

[An overview of our offers](https://www.val-muestair.ch/en/holiday-tips-guest-programme)

3.10.2027

Festa da la racolta – Harvest festival

On the first Sunday in October, locals and guests come together for the harvest festival in Valchava. The harvest festival is traditionally a popular destination for the whole family.

Humour and enjoyment: video tour through the Lower Engadine and Val Müstair

«The Culinary Grand Tour of Switzerland» sends food influencers Nico Franzoni and Noah Bachofen to meet people who love food – stopping off in the Lower Engadine and Val Müstair. The videos showcase our region's culinary gems with a touch of humour.
